meta.description: Production assets for the Math Quest kids game, located at public/kids/assets/math-quest/ alongside manifest.json, processed from Math-Quest-Assets/source-prompts originals (never modified).

conventions.dimensions: Pixel size as WxH. NOTE: legacy 'Kids assets/assets.txt' used the field name 'size' for dimensions ('1920x1080'); that convention is kept here under explicit 'dimensions'.
conventions.transparent: true when the image carries usable alpha channel.
conventions.filename: Path relative to this manifest file.
conventions.source: Path relative to the Math-Quest-Assets folder, where the source-prompts originals and the pipeline live; originals were not modified.
